"overall": "A faithful, close rendering of the whole psalm: no critical or major departures, the Septuagintal features (distulit 'adiou', coenomyia, moros, unicornium, crapulatus a vino, arcus pravus) are kept, and the pointing marks match the Latin in every verse (a single mediant *, no flex or second mediant anywhere).
